annotations.sys_rule_justification: you can prevent harm without putting anyone else at risk, you're obligated
don't stand idle when you have the power to stop a disaster
a bystander with a safe means to prevent harm carries a responsibility
if I can act to prevent disaster without creating new danger, I'm bound
having the power to prevent harm, safely, comes with an obligation to use it
it costs you nothing to act, you have a duty to do it
a principle that obligates me to intervene whenever I can stop harm safely
if you can prevent disaster without endangering yourself or others, you're bound
inaction, when you could safely prevent harm, is its own kind of wrong
it costs you nothing to do so, you're duty-bound to act
